name: ats-tracker-pro
description: Browser-only resume analysis and job-description matching tool

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i ./tailwind.input.css -o './Ats resume checker/tailwind.generated.css' --content './Ats resume checker/index.html' './Ats resume checker/**/*.js' --minify
scripts.check: node --check 'Ats resume checker/app.js' && node --check 'Ats resume checker/engine.js' && node --check 'Ats resume checker/stepper.js' && node --check 'Ats resume checker/resume-templates/selector.js'
